novelty.justification: The claim asks whether ESM-2 attention represents “physically proximal, energetically coupled residue pairs rather than statistical coevolution signals alone,” so its novelty route is a sharper mechanistic dissociation and measurement of two already-recognized sources of contact signal. Searches around “ESM-2 attention physical contacts versus coevolution,” “protein language model attention allostery,” and “PLM structural versus evolutionary statistics” identify the closest work as the 2024 preprint Protein language models learn evolutionary statistics of interacting sequence motifs, which already investigates whether ESM-2 contact predictions reflect biophysics or stored coevolutionary statistics; Single-Sequence, Structure Free Allosteric Residue Prediction with Protein Language Models (2024) also reports distant allosteric information in attention maps. Comparing attention and DCA specifically on “contacting-but-conserved” and “long-range coevolving-but-distant” pairs is a non-trivial operationalization, but it is a natural extension of that existing question rather than a new core relationship or interpretability paradigm.
